caption: The drawing depicts a single fantastical creature lying on a flat surface. The creature is rendered in dark, muted shades of gray and brown, with shading that emphasizes its three-dimensional form. Its body resembles that of a reptile or dragon, with a prominent head featuring an open mouth full of sharp teeth and a visible tongue. The eyes are small, and there are pronounced ridges along the head. Two legs are visible; one is bent beneath the body and the other extends outward with defined claws. Most notably, the creature has a large, spiraling, curled tail that loops upward and backward, with additional smaller curled appendages emerging near the base of the tail and from the top of the head. The background is a plain, light tan color, and the signature "Pearl Torell" appears near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Iron Dragon
